2609.04782.title: DODR: Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space
2609.04782.paper_summary: Autoregressive (AR) large language models formulate reasoning as token-level probabilistic sampling, which induces three fundamental defects in complex logical reasoning: error accumulation, probability substituting necessity, and the linear-chain information bottleneck. This paper proposes the Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space architecture (DODR), which reconstructs reasoning as reasoning-graph computation in a high-dimensional linear-algebraic space. Reasoning states are represented as snapshot vectors whose primitives are semantic units (phrases or sentences) rather than tokens, and each inference step is a deterministic matrix operation with no token sampling. Peirce's three inference types are formalized as three trainable matrix operators: a rank-deficient deduction operator (information collapse), a full-rank induction operator (information expansion), and an abduction operator defined as the Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse of deduction (information hypothesizing). We prove that the operator set is minimal and complete given Peirce's trichotomy, that no single "super-operator" can realize all three types (a rank obstruction), and that reasoning graphs are Turing-complete with contractive backflow converging by Banach's fixed-point theorem. Experiments on 503 sample records (420 deduplicated samples) across dedicated and end-to-end settings show: deduction loss converges to 1.40e-05; induction achieves 0.9996 generalization coverage with 20/20 hard vetoes on counterexamples; abduction solutions exceed the random baseline by 28x with judgment accuracies of 72.5% (58/80, Wilson 95% CI [61.9%, 81.1%]) and 81.7% (49/60, CI [70.1%, 89.4%]); frozen operators attain 100% (60/60) on unseen cross-domain deduction. The architecture provides a structural zero-hallucination guarantee and a three-layer continual-learning mechanism. All data and code are released.
2609.04782.paper_summary_zh: 自回歸 (AR) 大型語言模型將推理形式化為以標記為基礎的概率抽樣，這在複雜邏輯推理中引入了三個基本缺陷：錯誤累積、概率取代必要性，以及線性鏈信息瓶頸。本文提出了基於確定性運算符驅動潛在空間推理架構 (DODR)，將推理重構為高維線性代數空間中的推理圖計算。推理狀態被表示為快照向量，其原始單元是語義單位（短語或句子），而非標記，每一步推理都是一個確定性的矩陣運算，沒有標記抽樣。皮爾斯的三種推理類型被形式化為三個可訓練的矩陣運算符：一個秩不足的推導運算符（信息崩潰）、一個全秩的歸納運算符（信息擴展），以及一個定義為推導的摩爾-彭若斯偽逆的歸納運算符（信息假設）。我們證明了給定皮爾斯的三分法，運算符集是最小且完整的，沒有單一的「超運算符」能實現所有三種類型（秩障礙），並且推理圖是圖靈完備的，具有通過巴拿赫不動點定理收斂的收縮回流。在專用和端對端設置下對503個樣本記錄（420個去重樣本）的實驗顯示：推導損失收斂至1.40e-05；歸納達到0.9996的泛化覆蓋率，對反例的20/20硬否決；歸納解決方案超過隨機基線28倍，判斷準確率為72.5%（58/80，威爾遜95%置信區間[61.9%, 81.1%]）和81.7%（49/60，置信區間[70.1%, 89.4%]）；凍結運算符在未見的跨域推導上達到100%（60/60）。該架構提供了結構性零幻覺保證和三層持續學習機制。所有數據和代碼均已發布。
